shared_elements: carved relief on an upright/large stone monument
a face or head with prominent round eye
justification: Both surfaces carry relief carving in which a large rounded eye or spiral volute reads as part of a face-like head, which is the only reasonably specific correspondence. Otherwise A shows a densely packed, symmetrical, fully articulated frontal standing figure with headdress, ornaments and panelled ornament stacked vertically, while B shows only a single sparse, blocky motif on a boulder with no figure, no body, and no compositional register system.
